Love butter? Then get thee to Pierogies Plus.

I live in St. Louis, and it seems like the only pierogi I can find are in my grocer's freezer. Oh, but when I go home to Pittsburgh, I can have as much of the chewy, flavorful, buttery goodness as I desire from Pierogies Plus.

The place still looks like an old service station with a tiny building and a roof over an old gas pump island. Inside, though, magical elves... uh... I mean fabulous Polish women... create deliciousness with love -- and butter. Have I mentioned that butter is a part of the deal? Because it totally is. You really should fast for two days before picking up pierogi from here.

Oh, but you'll be happy you did. I'm vegetarian, so I only order meat-free pierogi. I'm in love with the saurkraut and the cheese varieties. When you pick up a hot order, you'll get your pierogi covered in with rich butter and sauteed onions. No, I'm serious -- the pierogi are SWIMMING in butter. It's the best thing ever. Everything is packed inside a styrofoam container and a plastic bag, because butter WILL spill out.

You also can order cold or frozen pierogi if you plan to, say, lug them to the middle of the country to enjoy in a far-off city.

Besides many varieties of pierogi, you also can get things from the deli cases. Last time, I had some apricot blintzes, a latke and some type of apple turnover thingy. I really hope Pierogies Plus has the blintzes when I visit next.

Awesome thing: Pierogies Plus usually has coupons in the Entertainment Book. My best friend and I steal all of the coupons from our families so that I can get a steady stream of discounted Polish goodness each time I visit.

The only downside is that Pierogies Plus often closes for several days around holidays. I totally understand it -- family time is important! -- but that often coincides with my visits (I head east around the holidays mainly because I get an extra day with the fam without having to take another vacation day). I've learned to plan my trips around the Pierogies Plus schedule, though, because I MUST have yummy goodness. A pierogi-less Allison is a cranky Allison.

James Wan es un director y productor australiano reconocido por sus obras de terror. Nacido en 1976, ha dirigido y producido varios de los films de terror más exitosos de la última década. Su estilo único y su habilidad para crear tensión y suspense han hecho de él uno de los directores más influyentes del género.

Wan comenzó su carrera cinematográfica con "Saw", una película de terror de bajo presupuesto que se convirtió en un éxito de taquilla y crítica. La película sigue a dos hombres que despertaron atrapados en una habitación sin salida y deben jugar un juego macabro para sobrevivir. La película se destacó por su habilidad para crear tensión y suspense, y por su trama retorcida y desafiante.

Desde entonces, Wan ha dirigido y producido varias películas de terror de gran éxito, incluyendo "Insidious", "The Conjuring" y "Annabelle". Todas estas películas comparten una sensación de terror realista y una atmósfera tenebrosa que atrapa al espectador desde el principio hasta el final. Además, Wan tiene un talento único para combinar elementos sobrenaturales con una narrativa sólida y personajes interesantes.

Otro aspecto que hace destacar a las obras de James Wan en el género del terror es su habilidad para crear ambientes aterradores y creíbles. Desde la casa embrujada en "The Conjuring" hasta la espeluznante habitación en "Saw", Wan utiliza la escenografía y la dirección de arte para crear una sensación de misterio y terror que se siente real y presente en todo momento.

Además de su trabajo en el género del terror, Wan también ha demostrado su versatilidad como director al dirigir películas en otros géneros, como la película de acción "Fast & Furious 7". Sin embargo, es su trabajo en el género del terror el que lo ha hecho famoso y lo ha colocado como uno de los directores más importantes y influyentes en la industria cinematográfica.

En resumen, las obras de James Wan en el género del terror son un ejemplo de cómo un director puede crear películas aterradoras, tensas y conmovedoras. Con su habilidad para crear ambientes terroríficos y personajes interesantes, Wan ha establecido un legado en la industria cinematográfica que lo ha convertido en uno de los directores más respetados y queridos en el género del terror.

Bessere Kühlleistung: Eine Wasser-Kühlung ist in der Regel effektiver als eine Luft-Kühlung, insbesondere bei hochleistungsfähigen PCs, bei denen die Komponenten viel Wärme erzeugen. Leiser: Im Vergleich zu Lüftern, die Lärm erzeugen können, ist eine Wasser-Kühlung in der Regel leiser.

Übertragbarkeit: Eine Wasser-Kühlung kann von einem PC zum nächsten übertragen werden, was bei einer Luft-Kühlung nicht möglich ist.

Nachteile eines wassergekühlten PCs:

Kosten: Eine Wasser-Kühlung ist in der Regel teurer als eine Luft-Kühlung.

Komplexität: Eine Wasser-Kühlung ist komplexer als eine Luft-Kühlung und erfordert mehr Wissen und Fähigkeiten bei der Installation.

I've done everything from mountain biking, to short hikes, to all day hikes in South Mountain. And first let me say that I feel that I've yet to really get into even a fraction of what South Mountain has to offer.

First off, the BEST place to get information on South Mountain is at HikeArizona.com. For SM specifically, go here http://hikearizona.com/traildex.php?ID=34&sRID=52&SHOW=YES

I've done all or parts of the Mormon Loop, Guadalupe Ridgeline, Desert Classic, Pima East Loop, Pima West Loop, Javalina, Dirt Road, National, Geronimo, and Telegraph Pass. In other words, I've been on many of the eastern trails but haven't even touched the western trails. I need to get on that!

With that said, these ARE shared trails. You very well may encounter mountain bikers on these trails. Some of them are VERY inconsider it and go racing down and run over everything. If I remember correctly, a lot of people consider SM as a mecca of mountain biking and some even train for competitive mountain biking here. And from my experience, it is pretty good for mountain biking... even though I suck at it.

With that said, I am more of a hiker. I enjoy getting away from the hustle and bustle of the city and mountain bikers nearly riding by and clipping your ankle can be a bit bleh of this mountain. I want peace and quiet, yo! So I am going to say this... if you're looking for solitude, you may not find it here - especially when the weather is nice and on the weekends. If you want solitude, you'd be better off in the White Tank Mountains, especially if you can muster a 14mile trip... or the Superstitions. Neither of those places have I ever encountered mountain bikers (The White Tanks actually has a designated area for bikes). Likewise, Piestawa and Camelback mountains are always packed with people.

So, know your goal. If it just for exercise, the South Mountain is one of my favorite, partially because it is close to my house. If I want no people then it is Superstitions or White Tanks.

This should go without saying, but bring water. Let me correct myself, bring more water than you think you'll ever need. Arizona is notorious for dehydrating people. I personally bring a Camelbak 3L (100oz) filled completely up with water. I also bring a few flashlights/headlamps just in case I find the sun setting on me when I'm still out there.

Which reminds me... I've done numerous night hikes with the moon on SM. I actually didn't need a night except a few times where I wanted to make sure of my footing. So, if you aren't afraid of the dark... I highly suggest going hiking at night! It also gives a WONDERFUL view of the big sprawling city we call home - Phoenix. It's view off the National and Geronimo is supa-dupa awesome.

With that said, I give this trail a 5 star only because I think it offers so much and has a lot of diversity. It's not a trail system that you get into and go "oh ****" a mile in and have to turn back. There are so many options to match your skill level and desired activity that it almost seems ridiculous. It may take a few times going to get a trail route figured out that you like (right amount of people, no bikes, good views, etc.) but once you do then it is golden.

On an impersonal note, parking can be busy during peak times. And, the gates close at sunset. You can still drive out after dark though. Park is dog friendly but please pack out what you pack in (I'm talking about dog poop here).

Enjoy and see you out on the trail!

PowerShell has a profile file that is similar to the .bashrc file in Bash. The file is a script that is executed every time you run PowerShell. It can be used to set environment variables, customize PowerShell prompts, add aliases, functions, and customize the like.

The profile file can be located in different places depending on the PowerShell version and operating system.
In most cases, the profile file is called "Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1". 

Here are the possible locations where you can find the file :

Current User, Current Host: 
$Home\Documents\WindowsPowerShell\Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1

Current user, all hosts: 
$Home\Documents\Profile.ps1

All users, current host: 
$PsHome\Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1

All users, all hosts: 
$PsHome\Profile.ps1

To create or edit your profile file, you can use any text editor, such as Notepad. You can also
use the PowerShell integrated scripting environment (ISE) or the PowerShell command-line interface (CLI).

To check the location of the profile file, you can use the following PowerShell cmdlet:

In PowerShell, type :
$PROFILE | Format-List *
This will display the path and other properties of the current profile file.

Controle de versão é um sistema que permite o gerenciamento de mudanças em arquivos ao longo do tempo. Em desenvolvimento de software, o controle de versão é essencial para gerenciar as alterações feitas no código-fonte e arquivos relacionados, permitindo que uma equipe de desenvolvedores trabalhe em conjunto de forma eficiente.

Os principais benefícios do controle de versão para o desenvolvimento de software em equipe incluem:

1. Colaboração: Com o controle de versão, várias pessoas podem trabalhar no mesmo código-fonte simultaneamente, sem interferir umas com as outras. Cada desenvolvedor pode criar uma cópia local do código, fazer alterações e, em seguida, mesclar suas alterações com as alterações feitas por outros desenvolvedores.

2. Histórico de alterações: O controle de versão mantém um histórico de todas as alterações feitas no código-fonte ao longo do tempo, permitindo que a equipe de desenvolvimento veja quem fez o que e quando. Isso é útil para solucionar problemas, identificar bugs e rastrear o progresso do desenvolvimento.

3. Ramificação e Mesclagem: O controle de versão permite a criação de ramos (branches), permitindo que os desenvolvedores trabalhem em diferentes recursos ou correções de bugs sem interferir no trabalho de outros desenvolvedores. Em seguida, esses ramos podem ser mesclados (merged) de volta ao ramo principal (trunk) do código-fonte.

4. Rollback: Em casos de falha em uma alteração ou atualização, o controle de versão permite reverter para uma versão anterior do código-fonte, evitando problemas futuros.

5. Melhorar a qualidade do código: O controle de versão pode ajudar a melhorar a qualidade do código-fonte, permitindo que os desenvolvedores revisem o código de outros membros da equipe, comentem e forneçam feedback construtivo.

Em resumo, o controle de versão é fundamental para o desenvolvimento de software em equipe, permitindo que os desenvolvedores trabalhem juntos de forma eficiente e gerenciem as alterações feitas no código-fonte ao longo do tempo. Isso leva a um melhor gerenciamento do projeto, melhor qualidade do código e, em última análise, a um produto de software de alta qualidade.

What is Vsan

VSAN stands for Virtual SAN, which is a software-defined storage solution offered by VMware for virtualized environments. It allows storage to be abstracted from physical hardware and managed as a virtualized resource, enabling the creation of a highly scalable and efficient storage infrastructure.

VSAN is built into the VMware vSphere hypervisor and uses local server disks to create a shared storage pool that can be used by virtual machines. It provides features such as data deduplication, compression, and encryption, as well as advanced data services like RAID, erasure coding, and stretch clustering.

Overall, VSAN simplifies storage management, reduces storage costs, and improves performance by making storage a native part of the virtual infrastructure.

Self-modifying code: Malbolge allows programs to modify themselves during execution, making it very difficult to predict the behavior of a program.
Instruction set: Malbolge has only three instructions, which makes it difficult to write efficient programs. The instructions are:
a self-modifying NOP instruction
a self-modifying input instruction
a self-modifying operation instruction
Debugging: Debugging Malbolge programs is extremely difficult due to the complex syntax and semantics of the language.

Our client’s mother approached our specialist erb’s palsy solicitors after realising that her son, Peter, may be eligible to claim compensation for the injuries he sustained during birth.
During her pregnancy with Peter, his mother had attended all of the scans and they showed a baby of normal size. However, during her labour, it became apparent that Peter was quite a big baby and, due to this, they took his mother to theatre to monitor her progress.
Peter’s head was delivered first, but due to his size, his shoulders became stuck (shoulder dystocia). Multiple attempts were made to deliver his body, including the use of a ventouse (vacuum cup) and forceps. The McRoberts position (a manoeuvre often used in this situation) was not adopted, nor was an episiotomy.
It was unclear from the records how long there was between the delivery of Peter’s head and his body, but the degree of trauma our client suffered to his head and neck was disproportionate to the amount of traction required to deliver a baby, even under these very difficult circumstances.
When Peter was born, he was floppy and not breathing on his own, so he needed help from machines. He also had a wound to his head as a result of the attempted delivery.
Peter recovered fairly well in NICU and was breathing independently. However, a lump on the side of his neck was noted and, after further investigation, it was found that he had suffered a severe brachial plexus injury that affected the nerves found at C5, C6 and C7. 
During the first 10 years of his life, our client underwent five separate procedures to try and improve the long-standing impact of his birth injuries, all of which only helped a little. Peter was unable to raise his right arm above shoulder height and had restrictive movement in his right shoulder. He also had significant scarring on his back due to the amount of surgery he required. Peter also suffered significant psychiatric damage as a result of his erb’s palsy and visible disability, which led to multiple attempts on his own life.

En la filosofía, hay muchas teorías diferentes sobre el principio y el fin de todo. Para algunos filósofos, como los antiguos griegos, el universo es eterno y no tiene un comienzo ni un fin definidos. Para otros, como los filósofos modernos, el universo puede haber tenido un comienzo con el Big Bang, pero su fin es incierto y puede ser influenciado por diferentes factores, como la expansión o el colapso de la energía oscura.

En última instancia, el principio y el fin de todo son cuestiones profundas y complejas que han sido objeto de debate y discusión durante siglos y probablemente continuarán siéndolo en el futuro.

## There are a few steps you can take to get back into shape:

1. Start small: It's important to start with manageable goals that you can realistically achieve. This will help build your confidence and motivate you to keep going.

2. Set a schedule: Plan out your workouts and schedule them into your week. Consistency is key to seeing progress.

3. Find an activity you enjoy: Whether it's going for a walk, bike ride, or taking a yoga class, find an activity that you enjoy and that you'll look forward to doing.

4. Increase activity levels throughout the day: Look for ways to increase your activity levels throughout the day, such as taking the stairs instead of the elevator, or going for a walk during your lunch break.

5. Incorporate strength training: Strength training can help build muscle mass and increase your metabolism, making it easier to burn calories and lose weight.

6. Stay motivated: Surround yourself with supportive people, track your progress, and reward yourself for reaching milestones.

Remember, getting back into shape takes time and effort. Be patient with yourself and celebrate small successes along the way.

Plato lived over 2,000 years ago and did not have direct knowledge of modern physics. However, he was a philosopher who believed in the existence of objective reality beyond our sensory experience. He also believed in the existence of eternal, unchanging Forms or Ideas that are the true reality behind the world of appearances.

In this sense, Plato might have been sympathetic to some aspects of modern physics that suggest the existence of underlying mathematical structures and laws governing the behavior of the universe. For example, he might have found the concept of a fundamental, unifying force or principle that governs all physical phenomena, such as the hypothetical "Theory of Everything" in modern physics, to be in line with his own idea of a single, ultimate reality that underlies all appearances.

The global refugee crisis refers to the significant number of people who have been forcibly displaced from their homes due to conflict, persecution, or other forms of violence. As of my knowledge cutoff in September 2021, the crisis remains a complex and ongoing issue.

The exact numbers and situations are subject to change, but according to the United Nations Refugee Agency (UNHCR), the number of forcibly displaced people reached an unprecedented high of around 82.4 million by the end of 2020. This includes refugees, internally displaced persons (IDPs), and asylum seekers.

Addressing the global refugee crisis requires a multi-faceted approach involving collaboration among nations, international organizations, and local communities. Here are some key considerations and potential solutions:

 Protection and Security: Ensuring the safety and security of refugees is paramount. Providing access to secure shelter, healthcare, education, and legal protection is crucial. Collaborating with humanitarian organizations and implementing robust legal frameworks can help safeguard the rights of refugees.

 Conflict Prevention and Resolution: Addressing the root causes of displacement by working toward peace, stability, and conflict resolution is essential. Diplomatic efforts, mediation, and international cooperation can help prevent conflicts and facilitate peaceful resolutions to ongoing crises.

 Global Burden-Sharing: Encouraging countries to share the responsibility and provide support for refugees is vital. This can be achieved through the fair distribution of refugees among countries, financial assistance, technical expertise, and capacity-building programs.

 Refugee Integration and Empowerment: Promoting the integration of refugees into host communities is important for their long-term well-being and self-sufficiency. This can be facilitated through language and skills training, access to education and employment opportunities, and initiatives that foster social cohesion.

 Development Aid and Investment: Providing development assistance to countries hosting large numbers of refugees can alleviate the strain on their resources. Investing in infrastructure, job creation, and economic development can benefit both refugees and host communities, reducing tensions and promoting stability.

 Addressing Climate Change and Displacement: Climate change is increasingly contributing to displacement. Taking proactive measures to mitigate and adapt to climate change, as well as assisting communities affected by environmental disasters, can help prevent further displacement and protect vulnerable populations.

 Long-Term Solutions: Efforts should focus on finding durable solutions for refugees, including voluntary repatriation, local integration, or resettlement in third countries. Collaboration among governments, international organizations, and civil society is necessary to facilitate these solutions.

It's important to note that the global refugee crisis is a complex and multifaceted issue, and the solutions will vary depending on the specific contexts and challenges faced in different regions. Continued dialogue, cooperation, and empathy are essential to addressing the crisis and supporting those in need.

Buenas tardes. Considero que el manga, las historietas y los cómics son una expresión artística auténtica. Estas formas de narración visual combinan el arte del dibujo, la composición, la narrativa y el diseño gráfico para transmitir historias y emociones de manera única. A continuación, argumentaré mi respuesta basándome en algunos valores importantes.
1.
Creatividad: El manga, las historietas y los cómics son formas de expresión altamente creativas. Los artistas y autores tienen la libertad de crear mundos imaginarios, personajes fascinantes y estilos artísticos únicos. La creatividad se manifiesta tanto en el diseño visual como en la narrativa de estas obras.
2.
Comunicación visual: Estas formas de arte utilizan el lenguaje visual para transmitir ideas, emociones y contar historias. La combinación de dibujos, viñetas, texto y diseño de página crea una experiencia de lectura visualmente atractiva y efectiva. Los artistas tienen la capacidad de transmitir mensajes y generar impacto a través de imágenes y secuencias narrativas.
3.
Variedad de géneros y estilos: El mundo del manga, las historietas y los cómics abarca una amplia gama de géneros y estilos artísticos. Desde obras de fantasía épica hasta comedia, ciencia ficción, drama y más, hay una diversidad de temas y enfoques artísticos para satisfacer diferentes gustos e intereses.
Si bien mencionaste a Jinji Ito como un autor destacado en el género de manga de terror, es importante señalar que hay muchos otros autores talentosos en diferentes géneros y estilos artísticos. Algunos ejemplos notables incluyen a Osamu Tezuka, autor de "Astro Boy", y Hayao Miyazaki, creador de "El viaje de Chihiro" y otras películas de Studio Ghibli.
En resumen, el manga, las historietas y los cómics son una forma de expresión artística auténtica debido a su creatividad, capacidad de comunicación visual y diversidad de géneros y estilos. Estas obras nos permiten sumergirnos en historias visualmente atractivas y nos invitan a apreciar el talento y la visión artística de sus creadores.

La elegante sintaxis de Python y su tipado dinámico, junto a su naturaleza interpretada lo convierten en un lenguaje ideal para scripting y desarrollo rápido de aplicaciones en muchas áreas, para la mayoría de plataformas.

El intérprete de Python y la extensa librería estándar se encuentran disponibles libremente en código fuente y de forma binaria para la mayoría de las plataformas desde la Web de Python, https://www.python.org/, y se pueden distribuir libremente. El mismo sitio también contiene distribuciones y referencias a muchos módulos libres de Python de terceros, programas, herramientas y documentación adicional.

El intérprete de Python es fácilmente extensible con funciones y tipos de datos implementados en C o C++ (u otros lenguajes que permitan ser llamados desde C). Python también es apropiado como un lenguaje para extender aplicaciones modificables.

Este tutorial introduce al lector informalmente a los conceptos básicos y las funcionalidades del lenguaje de programación Python y a su sistema. Ayuda a tener un interprete de Python accesible para una experiencia práctica, todos los ejemplos son auto-contenidos, permitiendo utilizar el tutorial sin conexión.

Para una descripción de los objetos estándar y de los módulos, ver La biblioteca estándar de Python. Referencia del Lenguaje Python dónde se ofrece una definición más formal del lenguaje. Para escribir extensiones en C o C++, leer Ampliación e incrustación del intérprete de Python y Manual de referencia de la API en C de Python. Existen diversos libros que cubren Python en detalle.

Este tutorial no pretende ser exhaustivo ni cubrir cada una de las características del lenguaje, ni siquiera las más utilizadas. En vez de eso, pretende introducir muchas de las funcionalidades más notables y brindar una idea clara acerca del estilo y el tipo de lenguaje que es Python. Después de leerlo podrás leer y escribir módulos y programas en Python, y estarás listo para aprender más acerca de las diversas librerías y módulos descritos en La biblioteca estándar de Python.

I haven't been a member of the Allegheny YMCA for very long, but I've had a great experience so far.

The building itself is on the older side -- I'd guess it's probably about 100 years old. The equipment, however, is pretty modern, and many of the rooms have been retrofitted for modern gym conveniences such as air conditioning. 

The Allegheny YMCA has the following features:
1) A room with cardio machines (some traditional elliptical trainers, some of the newer breed of elliptical trainers that are like a mating between a stair-stepper and an elliptical, rowing machines, and exercise bikes). Most of the cardio machines are only about a year old and have those weird little TVs mounted on top, so you can see Barack Obama's mouth silently moving as you get your workout.
2) A basketball court with a track on top of it (28 laps = 1 mile).
3) A spinning studio.
4) A pretty decent weightlifting room, with a good balance between weight machines and free weights. There's also a good range of free weights, so a weakling like me and a strong man like the dude I saw with biceps bigger than my waist can both use the weight room.
5) A pool that is not Olympic size, but is big enough to get in a decent workout by swimming lengths.
6) Secure access to the women's locker room (as well as to the fancy men's locker room).
7) A group exercise room. Group exercise classes are included in the membership fee, and the instructors are really nice and also inspiring/motivating. There's a good range of classes for all ages and fitness levels, including Pilates, yoga, water aerobics, spinning, and cardio kickboxing.

The membership fees are pretty reasonable here (a family membership for 2 adults and 2 children is $58/month plus a $125 joining fee), and if you are employed by UPMC, you get an additional discount.

Most importantly, the Allegheny YMCA is a very welcoming place, regardless of your age, gender, or current fitness level. Gyms can be intimidating if you aren't in the greatest shape to begin with, and some gyms have members who aren't kind towards women who aren't super-fit or super-skinny. But at the Allegheny Y, everyone I have met has been extremely friendly and nice to me, which is the best incentive to keep going to the gym.

The film is based on Philip K. Dick's novel, Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?, and is considered one of the greatest science fiction films of all time. It is a complex film that raises important questions about the nature of humanity and the consequences of technological progress.
One of the central themes of Blade Runner is the blurring of the line between humans and replicants. The replicants are designed to be nearly identical to humans, but with increased strength and agility. However, they also possess emotions and desires, which raises the question of whether they are truly just machines or if they have become something more. This is best exemplified in the character of Roy Batty, the leader of the rogue replicants, who is portrayed as being more human than his creators.
Another important theme in Blade Runner is the impact of technology on humanity. The film portrays a future where technology has advanced to the point of being nearly omnipotent, but at the same time, it has also brought about environmental destruction, overpopulation, and social decay. This serves as a warning about the dangers of unrestrained technological progress and the importance of considering the long-term consequences of our actions.
In conclusion, Blade Runner is a complex film that explores important themes such as the nature of life and humanity.
It also touches on the danger of letting technology rule our future and the ethical dilemmas of becoming god like creators, who create beings in our own image to carry forward our wishes.

Faster time to market: DevOps focuses on automation and continuous delivery, allowing organizations to release software updates more frequently and rapidly respond to customer needs. This increased speed of delivery can give businesses a competitive edge in the market.

The Feynman path integral is a powerful formula in physics that suggests our reality is a sum of all possible realities. It is used to predict the behavior of quantum systems, such as electrons, light rays, and black holes. The double-slit experiment is a quintessential example of how the path integral works, as it implies that both of the particles possible paths through the barrier have a physical reality. The path integral can also be used to calculate the behavior of quantum fields, such as the electromagnetic field. However, mathematicians are uneasy with the path integral due to its reliance on infinite possibilities. Physicists are still trying to understand the quantum origin of gravity, and the path integral is expected to capture this behavior. There is debate over whether to include all possible shapes of space-time in the path integral, as this could lead to time travel paradoxes. Despite the confusion, physicists have managed to use the path integral to calculate properties of particles and estimate the path integral for the strong force.

¿Por qué hay que oír –y escuchar y ver– Candide?
Porque esta obra resume sonoramente las peripecias de Cándido, en un ejercicio sintético habilidoso; porque muestra un lenguaje sonoro propio, que identifica al autor; porque provoca reflexión; y porque ha trascendido en el tiempo, ya que, más de sesenta años después de su creación, vuelve a interpretarse en el mundo occidental. En este año de 2018, se conmemora el centenario del nacimiento de su autor: Leonard Bernstein. 
De esta ópera, la parte que más veces se interpreta, en versión de concierto, es su obertura. ¿Qué es una obertura? Una obertura es la apertura, la «puerta que da acceso» a una peripecia musical; la que abre un suceso, en este caso, escénico. Suele contener una parte de los motivos y temas que podremos oír y desarrollar en los episodios. Pero la obertura es, también, un elemento que puede configurarse como algo autónomo y no perteneciente a un corpus mayor. De hecho, la obertura ha ido evolucionando con el discurrir de los siglos, y pudimos distinguir entre oberturas «a la francesa», «a la italiana» u otras. Antaño, se trataba sólo de un aviso, de una llamada de atención –conocida, en algún caso, como toccata–, para indicar que comenzaba el espectáculo; una especie de prólogo; una fantasía, una introducción antes de que el telón fuera levantado. Es en Venecia, y también con Claudio Monteverdi, donde encontramos un punto de partida, que luego Jean-Baptiste Lully, en la segunda mitad del siglo XVII, desarrolló en la Francia de Luis XIV –el rey bailarín–, y que sería adoptada en Inglaterra y en los reinos alemanes. A partir del siglo XIX, y con Charles Gounod, encontramos la obertura dramática como resumen de la peripecia escénica. La obertura «extendida» dará lugar a un prólogo de corte wagneriano (Das Rheingold –El oro del Rin–) de más de dos horas de duración –¡menuda «obertura»!–. Sin embargo, la ópera italiana del siglo XIX, prácticamente, la hace desaparecer. La obertura de Cándido sólo dura cuatro minutos.

El modelado por homología, como se describe en, es un método de predicción de la estructura de proteínas basado en la comparación de una secuencia de proteína desconocida con proteínas de estructura conocida. Si la similitud entre la proteína desconocida y la proteína conocida es alta y el alineamiento es bueno, se puede construir un modelo de la proteína desconocida basado en la estructura de la proteína conocida.

Por otro lado, AlphaFold, como se describe en numerosas fuentes, es un algoritmo de inteligencia artificial desarrollado por DeepMind que utiliza el aprendizaje profundo para predecir la estructura de proteínas a partir de su secuencia. AlphaFold utiliza una red neuronal para predecir la estructura de una proteína a partir de la información de su secuencia, utilizando datos de experimentos biofísicos previos para entrenar la red neuronal.

En resumen, la principal diferencia entre el modelado por homología y el algoritmo utilizado por AlphaFold es que el primero se basa en la comparación de una secuencia de proteína desconocida con proteínas de estructura conocida para predecir la estructura, mientras que AlphaFold utiliza un enfoque basado en el aprendizaje profundo y el entrenamiento con datos experimentales previos para predecir la estructura de proteínas a partir de su secuencia.

Aprender Braille puede ser un proceso gratificante, pero es importante tener paciencia y practicar regularmente. Aquí te proporciono un desglose de los temas para aprender Braille, desde principiante a avanzado:

**Nivel Principiante:**

1. **Historia y conceptos básicos:** Familiarízate con la historia y el propósito del sistema Braille, cómo se desarrolló y cómo se utiliza en la actualidad.

2. **El alfabeto Braille:** Aprende los símbolos Braille correspondientes a cada letra del alfabeto. Comienza con las letras mayúsculas y minúsculas.

3. **Números:** Aprende los símbolos Braille para los números del 0 al 9 y cómo se utilizan en combinación con las letras.

4. **Puntuación y signos especiales:** Conoce los símbolos Braille para la puntuación común y otros signos especiales que se utilizan en Braille.

**Nivel Intermedio:**

5. **Palabras y contracciones:** Aprende las contracciones Braille y las abreviaturas utilizadas para representar palabras y grupos de letras comunes, lo que facilita la escritura y lectura más rápida.

6. **Números avanzados y matemáticas:** Familiarízate con símbolos Braille más avanzados para notación matemática, como operadores matemáticos, fracciones y símbolos especiales.

7. **Letras acentuadas y letras extranjeras:** Aprende cómo se representan las letras acentuadas y letras de otros idiomas en Braille.

**Nivel Avanzado:**

8. **Formato y estructura de documentos:** Aprende cómo se formatean los documentos en Braille, incluyendo títulos, párrafos, sangrías, listas, etc.

9. **Música en Braille:** Si estás interesado en música, puedes aprender cómo se notan las partituras y otros elementos musicales en Braille.

10. **Uso de tecnología y dispositivos Braille:** Explora cómo se utilizan dispositivos y tecnologías específicas para Braille, como impresoras Braille y dispositivos electrónicos.

**Consejos para aprender Braille de forma rápida:**

- **Practicar regularmente:** Dedica tiempo cada día o varias veces a la semana para practicar el Braille. La práctica constante te ayudará a mejorar rápidamente.

- **Utiliza recursos específicos:** Busca libros de texto y materiales diseñados específicamente para aprender Braille, ya que pueden proporcionar una progresión adecuada y ejercicios prácticos.

- **Aplicaciones y programas educativos:** Existen aplicaciones y programas educativos interactivos que te ayudarán a aprender Braille de forma más eficiente y entretenida.

- **Encuentra compañeros de aprendizaje:** Si es posible, busca grupos o comunidades de personas que estén aprendiendo Braille. El apoyo mutuo y la práctica con otros pueden ser muy útiles.

- **Practica la lectura y escritura:** Para aprender Braille, tanto leer como escribir son importantes. La práctica de ambas habilidades te ayudará a consolidar lo que aprendes.

Recuerda que el aprendizaje de Braille puede ser diferente para cada persona, así que adapta tu enfoque según tus necesidades y ritmo de aprendizaje. ¡Buena suerte en tu camino para aprender Braille!

El maíz tiene varias etapas fenológicas que se pueden dividir en las siguientes:

1. Germinación: en esta etapa, la semilla de maíz comienza a absorber agua y los brotes de la semilla empiezan a crecer hacia la superficie.

2. Emergencia: el brote de la semilla comienza a emerger de la superficie del suelo y crece rápidamente.

3. Desarrollo vegetativo: en esta fase se desarrollan las hojas y los tallos de la planta de maíz.

4. Formación de espigas: en esta etapa, la planta comienza a crecer la espiga y los pelos de la mazorca que eventualmente se convertirán en el maíz.

5. Floración y polinización: en esta etapa la planta comienza a florecer y los estigmas de la mazorca reciben el polen.

6. Desarrollo de la mazorca: la mazorca comienza a crecer y llenarse con los granos de maíz.

7. Madurez: la mazorca completa su desarrollo y los granos de maíz se endurecen y se vuelven secos.

Cada una de estas etapas es crítica para el desarrollo exitoso del maíz, y los agricultores deben monitorearlas cuidadosamente para asegurarse de que las plantas crezcan saludables y fuertes y produzcan una buena cosecha.

This script assumes that you have folders named 'Documents', 'Pictures', and 'Videos' on your desktop. If you don't have these folders, you can either create them manually or modify the script to create them automatically.

```python
import os
import shutil

# Set the path to your desktop
desktop_path = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser('~'), 'Desktop')

# Define the folders for each file type
folders = {
 'Documents': ['.doc', '.docx', '.txt', '.pdf', '.xls', '.xlsx', '.ppt', '.pptx'],
 'Pictures': ['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.bmp', '.ico', '.tiff', '.tif'],
 'Videos': ['.mp4', '.mkv', '.flv', '.avi', '.mov', '.wmv'],
}

# Iterate through each file on the desktop
for file in os.listdir(desktop_path):
 file_path = os.path.join(desktop_path, file)

 # Skip folders
 if os.path.isdir(file_path):
 continue

 # Get the file extension
 file_ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1]

 # Iterate through the folders dictionary to find the appropriate folder for the file
 for folder, extensions in folders.items():
 if file_ext.lower() in extensions:
 # Set the destination path for the file
 destination = os.path.join(desktop_path, folder)

 # Move the file to the appropriate folder
 shutil.move(file_path, os.path.join(destination, file))
 print(f'Moved {file} to {folder}')
 break
```
Copy the code above into a new Python file (e.g., organize_files.py) and execute the script by running python `organize_files.py` in the command prompt or terminal. This script will sort the files on your desktop based on their extensions and move them to the appropriate folders ('Documents', 'Pictures', or 'Videos').

I love zoos and animals, so I was looking forward to checking out the Raptor Center. We had my niece and nephew last weekend (ages 6 and 3) so we decided to take them there to check out the birds.

I enjoyed the center and felt the price was right for the amount of exhibits and time it takes to get around ($10 adults, free kids under 4). The Raptor Center is a sanctuary for birds who would not make it in the wild, and they go to schools to educate young kids about raptors, so I didn't exactly feel bad paying since I knew it was going to a good cause. They had several different kinds of owls, eagles, hawks, vultures and other predatory birds. Most of the habitats seemed to be a decent size for the animal inside, and the birds themselves seemed relatively comfortable. There was also a little playground based on Harry Potter for the kids to play in, and they liked that. The staff there were very friendly and informative, and several who were transporting a bird from one area to the next were more than happy to take a few seconds to tell us a little about the bird and let the kids get a good look at it.

My nephew really enjoyed looking at all the birds, and he even knew a little on his own since the center had brought some birds over to his school. My three year old niece didn't care for it as much and was more interested picking rocks and thistles out of the dirt then looking at birds in cages. I was really glad that she was free and we didn't have to pay for her!

Overall, it's a really clean, friendly, and educational experience. Check out some cool looking birds while walking the trails and learn about these beautiful raptors. Great for kids and adults.

Assuming that powering off your computer is not the direction you were thinking, there are several ways to exit vim. Each of them requires you to hit Escape to enter normal mode for the editor. After you're in normal mode:
- `:q` will quit if you haven't modified anything
- `:q!` quits and discards any changes you might have made without prompting
- `:wq` is the typical way to exit immediately after writing your changes. If you don't have write access, then vim will not quit
- `:x` is a synonym for `:wq`, mostly, except that it will only write new file metadata if changes were actually made
- `:wq!` tries to write changes but quits no matter the outcome, discarding changes if any error happens
- `:qa` this quits everything, but I've never used it, personally
- `:cq` quiits and throws an error
- `:help` is a good choice for other options

As a U of I grad, I can't stress enough the amazing experiences I have had from Illinois. From social, academic, and personal points of view, my time at Illinois has influenced every aspect of my being. From a social standpoint, the school has over 40,000 students and one of the biggest Greek communities in the nation. The study abroad program is amazing and provides the opportunity to see the world and get your education. I was lucky enough to study abroad in Spain and travel over Europe while I was there. 

From an academic standpoint the quality of education you get for the money is well worth it, and probably one of the cheaper colleges in Illinois unless you are going to a community college. When I attended the university, my tuition was about $8000 a semester which included tuition plus room and board. Off the top of my head, Illinois has some of the best agriculture, engineering, and veterinary programs in the country. The school offers a variety of classes to produce well rounded and worldly graduates. There are resources to help with interviewing skills, resumes, and job connection. 

The athletics at U of I is also something to get excited about and have pride in. While I went there the basketball team went to the national championship and after I left the football team went to the rose bowl. There is nothing like supporting your school and bleeding orange and blue. 

On a personal note, I lived in both the dorms and in an apartment, two experiences I would suggest for anyone. Though I never joined a sorority, my now husband was in a fraternity and had the time of his life. The towns are small but more industry is slowly creeping its way down to Champaign/Urbana. The main drag at U of I is Green Street and all the bars and shops near school with the cheap prices made my time at U of I one of the best times in my life. If I could go back in time to relive it all, I would! It is the quintessential college experience!

The workers arrived again in a few days and fixed the issue. No extra charge. 

We will use Porter again in the future if needed. 

Few things you must know. When you call the office, if you get the office clerk, you might not get the same level of service from her as needed so best thing to do is go to their website and call Dennis on his cell phone directly. Randy the superintendent is very nice but is not good at calling you back to re-schedule etc. For example, he said he would call to let me know when the workers would show up again but he didn't. - Validate their feelings: Let them know that it's okay to feel unsure and that it's a common experience.

- Identify the source of the worry: Ask questions to help the person understand the source of their worry and what is driving their second thoughts.

- Consider alternatives: Together, look at different options and weigh the pros and cons to help the person make a more informed decision.

- Encourage them to take action: Sometimes taking even a small step can help to reduce anxiety and uncertainty.

- Provide support: Let the person know that you are there to support them, regardless of their decision.
